instruction: Search for Nerf blasters for boys and sort the results starting with the highest price.

metadata.explanation: Task requires searching for Nerf blasters for boys on kohls.com and sorting by price high-low. Same complexity as original with different toy category. Uses check_direct_json_object evaluator.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses active_tab_html_parse getter to extract both HTML class elements and URL parameters
Getter extracts breadcrumb navigation (Nerf, Blasters, Boys) from class pmpSearch_breadcrumb
Getter extracts sort selection (Price High-Low) from class sbSelector
Getter validates URL contains search keywords (Nerf/nerf, Blasters, Boys) and sort parameter (S=5)
Metric check_direct_json_object correctly compares extracted data against expected rules
All instruction requirements are verified: search terms (Nerf, blasters, boys) and sort order (price high-low)
Logic handles case-insensitive matching and checks for unexpected filters (is_other_exist)
Expected values use correct lowercase format matching getter output
Complete coverage: verifies both search filters AND sort order as required by instruction
